text:
About Nous

Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.

We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.

We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.

Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.

And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people".

The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build.

The role

What Nous does for members can feel simple: helping them understand their bills, save money, and avoid admin. Delivering that reliably at scale is much harder.

You’ll join the Operations team at the heart of the business, working on the difficult real-world problems that sit between our members, our product, external suppliers and the systems that make Nous work.

This is not a traditional customer operations role. You’ll spend time close to our members, understanding their questions, investigating things that have gone wrong and learning in detail how our service works. We think that matters: the best systems are usually built by people who have seen the underlying problems first-hand.

But we don’t want you simply to get faster at doing manual work. We want you to spot the pattern, understand why the problem exists, and help build a better way of doing it.

That might mean redesigning a process, building an automation, using AI to remove repetitive work, querying data to understand what is happening, improving an internal tool, or working with Product and Engineering on a more fundamental fix.

You don't need to arrive knowing all of the tools we use. We care much more about how quickly you learn them.

We’re looking for someone early in their career who is unusually curious, quick to learn and good at figuring things out. You might already have built automations or small products yourself. You might instead have worked in operations, consulting, product, anal

title: Analytics Engineer
text:
Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”?

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents. We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

The job

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

  • Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

  • Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

  • Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

  • Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

  • Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

  • Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

Why you’ll want it

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

You’ll fit if you have

  • 1-2+ years in a data or analytics role

  • A technical or quantitative degree, or equivalent experience

  • Strong SQL and experience wrangling messy, complex data

text:
We are looking for someone to join us as an early member of the Web team, to build and own web platforms that turn large amounts of data into products people love to use. Maps and location data sit at the core of what we build, and we’re looking for an engineer who can take a platform from data model to pixel.

In the initial months, you’ll work closely with the team, gradually taking ownership of central systems and features. Given our stage, we’re seeking versatile engineers comfortable contributing across the frontend, the backend and the data.

Platform Engineering

Designing and building robust, scalable web platforms end-to-end in TypeScript: APIs, services, data access layers and the UI on top of them. You’ll make the architectural decisions and set the patterns that others build on.

Workflows & Data Pipelines

Architecting durable, long-running workflows and background processes on our workflow orchestration system (Restate). You’ll also build the pipelines that move data between our warehouse, our databases and our products, reliably and at scale.

Modeling large datasets so they can be queried and visualized fast. Maps & Geospatial Data

Bringing geospatial data to life on the web. You’ll render large amounts of location data on interactive maps, and keep them as fast and polished as they are insightful.

Roadmap Creation and Ideation

Contributing actively to the roadmap: identifying the right tradeoffs and bringing ideas from both a product and an engineering perspective.

Owning your scope

You’ll be responsible for the architecture, performance, monitoring and reliability of everything you ship. We value engineers who take full ownership of their scope, and who proactively address issues before anyone asks.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer

text:
About Prefiro

Asparagus cost up to 25 euros per kilo this season! That’s because, like most of the produce on the shelf, it’s harvested exclusively by hand. Here at Prefiro, we’re the first to automate these processes! We use artificial intelligence, and robotics to bring next-generation agricultural equipment to the field.

Are you excited about applying new technologies in real-world conditions, solving interesting and varied problems, and seeing firsthand the impact your ideas have?

Then join our growing team and help us deliver the first autonomous asparagus harvester to farms.

Your responsibilities

  • Integrate robots and IO into the robotics stack – from startup and service to error handling and recovery.

  • Work on MPC-based trajectory planning and optimal control: from approach to implementation on the robot in real time.

  • Help optimize cycle times in real-world applications

  • Scale the stack from one robot module to several per machine: networking, robot setup and calibration.

  • Tune the robot computers for real-time control: Docker, CPU pinning, ROS 2 scheduling and multithreading.

  • Build remote access, data collection and robotics CI/CD (e.g. rosbag-playback tests) to improve the robots with real field data.

  • Review code, contribute to architecture decisions and debug the stack as a team.

  • Run the robots during pre-season field tests and the harvest season.

What you bring

  • Master's Degree in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in robotics, including hands-on work with real robots (not only simulation).

  • Strong modern C++ (C++17) and Python 3.

  • Hands-on experience with ROS 2 (ideally Jazzy): nodes, lifecycle nodes, executors, QoS, launch files.

  • Experience with trajectory controllers and trajectory planning.

  • Solid grounding in robot kinematics and dynamics (URDF, Pinocchio or similar).

  • Proven experience with optimal control and model predictive control for trajectory planning; reinforcement learning is a plus.

  • Comfortable with CMake/colcon builds and Git on Linux.

  • Experience with real-time robot control and an understanding of soft real-time constraints on Linux (scheduling, latency, threading).

  • Fluent English, our working language.

Nice to have

  • Industrial arms, especially Denso SCARA (b-CAP, RC8) or Universal Robots.

  • Optimal-control frameworks such as acados or CasADi; control barrier functions.

  • MoveIt 2 or Ruckig for motion planning.

  • Docker, GitLab CI and automated testing (GoogleTest, launch_testing).

  • DDS or Zenoh tuning and multi-robot setups.

  • Debugging tools such as RViz, Foxglove, PlotJuggler or Nsight Systems.

  • Field deployment with systemd, tmux and shell scripting.

  • Basic German.

What we offer

  • Real fields from your first season. Your code runs on our machines on farms in Germany.

  • Short way from code to robot. New ideas usually run on the real machine within a few days.

  • A problem worth solving. Green asparagus is still harvested entirely by hand.

  • A small, motivated team that gets a lot done together. When you join, we're 8 full-time, plus 2 interns and a working student.

  • Open culture, flat hierarchies. We are still early, so your opinion counts in technical decisions.

  • Lunch and coffee together in the kitchen in our hall.

text:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question.

This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
text:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day.

As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you.

You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together.

You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date.

You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence.

You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law.

You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter.

You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

  • You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years.

  • Strong experience in agentic AI.

  • You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

  • You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses.

  • You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough.

title: Data Engineer
text:
De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering.  

Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. 

 

Wat ga je doen?  

Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt.

Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken.

Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk.

Continu leren is geen optie, maar de norm
Technologie staat niet stil, en jij ook niet. Bij PuurData is training verplicht. Je blijft op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen, denk aan Elastic, AI-integraties en nieuwe dataplatformen, en past die kennis direct toe in klantprojecten.


Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ondernemende professional die weinig sturing nodig heeft. Je denkt vanuit de eindgebruiker en streeft naar maximale klanttevredenheid zonder kwaliteit en veiligheid uit het oog te verliezen. Dankzij jouw analytisch vermogen zie je snel de kern van een probleem en kom je met creatieve, structurele oplo ssingen. Je kunt technische keuzes helder onderbouwen en klanten daarin meenemen, ook als het complex is. Daarin mag je best een tikkeltje eigenwijs zijn.


Nog geen doorgewinterde expert?

Geen probleem. Als je leergierig bent en en affiniteit hebt met data, komen we graag met je in contact.

text:
About pplwise
pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics
Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots.

About the role
This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind.

The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end: requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale, not just in the lab.

What you’ll do

  • Take full ownership of a complex PCB project and get it running in as few revisions as possible

  • Design high-power and high-speed circuits and make sure they work together at system level

  • Design for EMC, manufacturability and testability, and take boards through EMC testing and certification

  • Bring new technical approaches to the team, for example a new converter architecture that enables higher charging power in a smaller package

  • Introduce useful processes from your experience, such as simulation workflows that validate a layout before it goes to production

  • Help with board bring-up and debugging together with Embedded Software, and support Production with clear documentation and training

  • Take over ownership of existing boards so the team shares responsibility

About you

  • Several years designing electronics in an R&D environment at a smaller hardware company driven by innovation (e.g. robotics, e-mobility, aviation, autonomous vehicles, motion control)

  • A proven record of taking PCBs within a larger system from requirements to a validated product

  • Strong skills in schematic design and PCB layout (Altium, KiCad, OrCAD or similar)

  • Hands-o

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

What you will own and deliver

  • The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong.

  • The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows.

title: Co-Founder & CTO (gn), Industrial Data for AI, Paris
text:
About FoodLabs

FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch.

About The General Data Corporation

General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale.

Why this is a unique opportunity

AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity.

General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani, you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up.

About the role

  • Supplier intake: Build connectors for where companies actually keep their data: Databases, document stores, ticketing systems, machine logs, and sensor and video archives. 

  • Transaction layer: Own the pipeline, rights evidence, contracts, permissions, audit trail and delivery API.

  • ML and data quality: Build anonymisation across text, tables, images and video, plus re-identification checks, deduplication, quality scoring and tooling that turns raw records into training-ready data. 

  • Delivery and compute: Decide whether data is processed in our cloud or inside the supplier’s environment. Build secure delivery, recurring updates and our GPU infrastructure.

  • Technical direction: Own the architecture and roadmap. Work directly with labs, suppliers and researchers to understand what the system needs to become.

title: 3D Chiplet Engineer
text:
About Us : AI compute is hitting a hard physical wall, and memory bottlenecks are throttling the entire industry. Founded in October 2024 and backed by €57M in funding, Vertical Compute is solving this with proprietary Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM™) chiplets, making AI hardware faster, greener, and vastly more scalable. We are an interdisciplinary team transforming breakthrough semiconductor physics into commercial reality.

Our underlying technology is validated, and we have successfully met our core technical milestones. Armed with a proven technical data package and ongoing system studies, we are now shifting from pure R&D to active engagement with global enterprise customers. As we prepare for our next phase of scale and growth starting in 2027, joining us today means taking direct ownership of the hardware foundation that will power the next era of AI compute.

  • Debuggen/functioneel testen in Labview: bijvoorbeeld na uitval op de functionele tester.

  • Sustainable analyseren: uitzoeken wat er is gebeurd, waarom is dit gebeurd en hoe we dit in de toekomst kunnen voorkomen.

Werken bij Benchmark betekent werken in een dynamische werkomgeving. Je werkt in een zelfstandig team waar jouw initiatieven en ideeën zeer op prijs worden gesteld. Het team bestaat uit 13 collega’s en is een hechte groep waarin iedereen bereid is om elkaar te helpen.

title: wo-stage statistiek: data-analyse en weegmethoden
text:
wo-afstudeerstage, start in overleg

Op zoek naar een statistiekstage?
Analyseer bij het CBS weegmethoden en non-respons met R en draag bij aan betere statistieken voor Nederland.

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het CBS trekt steekproeven onder de Nederlandse bevolking om diverse statistieken te maken. Hierbij is sprake van selectieve non-respons. Om voor deze non-respons te corrigeren, voeren we een zogenaamde weging uit, waarbij personen een gewicht krijgen op basis van hun onder- of oververtegenwoordiging in de respons. Personen met achtergrondkenmerken die ondervertegenwoordigd zijn in de respons, krijgen dan een groter gewicht dan personen met achtergrondkenmerken die oververtegenwoordigd zijn. Zie bijvoorbeeld [1] voor algemene informatie over wegen.

Bij het uitvoeren van een weging zijn er diverse zaken om rekening mee te houden. Zo kan niet voor alle achtergrondkenmerken worden gecorrigeerd voor scheefheid, omdat de gewichten dan te extreem zouden worden. Daarnaast is het vaak verstandig om überhaupt niet voor te veel achtergrondkenmerken te corrigeren, omdat dit een negatieve invloed heeft op de marges van de schattingen voor de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek. Ook is er een relatie met de doelvariabelen in het onderzoek: op het moment dat er een samenhang is tussen een achtergrondkenmerk en de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek, is het wenselijk om wél voor dat achtergrondkenmerk te corrigeren als dat kenmerk scheef in de respons zit. Het is daarom vaak verstandig om toch zo veel mogelijk te corrigeren voor scheefheid in achtergrondkenmerken.

Het CBS heeft een reguliere werkwijze voor het opstellen en uitvoeren van wegingen voor reguliere onderzoeken. Een optie die nog niet wordt gebruikt, maar wel interessant lijkt, is het uitvoeren van een zogenaamde voorweging. Hierbij wordt de weging min of meer in twee stappen uitgevoerd, waardoor er mogelijk voor meer en/of andere achtergrondkenmerken gecorrigeerd kan worden. Wellicht is het mogelijk om eerst een correctie uit te voeren voor non-respons en vervolgens een verdere weging uit te voeren die meer focust op de doelvariabelen van het onderzoek en de achtergrondkenmerken die daarmee correleren. Dit soort vragen speelt zowel bij de reguliere steekproeven die bij het CBS worden uitgevoerd als bij potentiële nieuwe toepassingen. In deze stage ga je aan de slag om verschillende opties voor de weging te analyseren, te kijken naar de verschillen tussen deze opties en te bepalen welke keuze de voorkeur heeft.

Afhankelijk van de resultaten zouden weegmethoden aangepast kunnen worden, met directe impact op de statistieken van het CBS.

[1] https://www.cbs.nl/nl-nl/onze-diensten/methoden/statistische-methoden/throughput/throughput/wegen-als-correctie-voor-non-respons

title: wo-stage statistiek: data-analyse kwaliteit van de respons
text:
wo-afstudeerstage, start in overleg

Ben jij die nieuwsgierige statistiekstudent die energie krijgt van data-analyse en complexe vraagstukken? Wil je onderzoeken hoe keuzes in het steekproefproces de respons en kwaliteit van statistieken beïnvloeden? Tijdens deze afstudeerstage bij het CBS duik je in echte data, werk je met R en draag je bij aan betere statistieken voor Nederland.

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het CBS trekt steekproeven onder de Nederlandse bevolking om diverse statistieken te maken. Hierbij is sprake van selectieve nonrespons. We ondernemen diverse pogingen om de respons zo gelijkmatig mogelijk te laten zijn (naar diverse achtergrondkenmerken van personen). We proberen daarbij zo veel mogelijk respons binnen te krijgen, maar kijken tegelijkertijd ook naar de samenstelling van de respons. In het bijzonder kijken we daar bij diverse onderzoeken naar in de vorm van doelgroepgericht benaderen [1].

Omdat het verzenden van brieven steeds duurder wordt, wordt de afweging tussen kwaliteit en kosten ook voor onderzoeken die alleen via internetwaarneming plaatsvinden steeds relevanter. Bij dit soort onderzoeken worden meerdere brieven verstuurd als personen niet direct de vragenlijst invullen. Omdat deze brieven steeds duurder worden, lijkt het voor de hand te liggen om geen herinneringen te sturen naar personen die nog niet gerespondeerd hebben, maar tegelijkertijd ook tot groepen behoren die al voldoende gerespondeerd hebben. In zekere zin zou dit ook een doelgroepgerichte benadering zijn.

In deze stage ga jij aan de slag met een van de kernprocessen binnen het CBS: het trekken en uitbaten van de steekproef.
Dit raakt de kern van onze processen: zonder data van goede kwaliteit kunnen we geen hoogwaardige statistieken maken.
Jij gaat kijken naar de gevolgen voor onze statistieken van diverse keuzes die we bij het design kunnen maken. Zijn er verschuivingen in de samenstelling van de respons en zo ja, kunnen we begrijpen waarom die verschuivingen er zijn? En, misschien nog wel belangrijker, is er nog iets te merken van eventuele verschuivingen bij het maken van de statistieken? Wat gebeurt er als je bepaalde groepen weglaat uit de respons? 

Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten is het wellicht handig en wenselijk om een soort doelgroepenbenadering in te voeren bij onderzoeken met alleen CAWI-waarneming. Gezien de stijgende kosten van het versturen van brieven, zou het zomaar kunnen dat we dit daadwerkelijk in gaan voeren.

[1] Doelgroepenbenadering (adaptief survey design) | CBS

title: Data Engineer
text:
Een pipeline die 's nachts breekt? Jij levert de structurele fix, niet de workaround. Een query die te veel kost? Jij ziet meteen waar het misgaat. Bij Follo leunt performance marketing volledig op data die klopt: elke bieding, elk klantrapport en elk AI-model dat we inzetten hangt af van de pipelines die data uit allerlei bronnen naar ons datawarehouse brengen.

Wij geloven dat daar de toekomst ligt, dus we blijven doorbouwen en investeren de komende jaren flink in onze data-infrastructuur. Daarvoor zoeken we iemand die weet hoe je datastructuren neerzet, monitort en zo kostenefficiënt mogelijk laat draaien. Je bouwt zowel de warehouses als de pipelines en zorgt dat alles feilloos functioneert. Je denkt vanuit architectuur en kiest oplossingen die er over twee jaar nog staan, ook als de tooling eromheen verandert. Tegelijk snap je dat een agency snel moet kunnen schakelen. Dat evenwicht is waar deze rol om draait.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert ETL- en ELT-workflows die meegroeien met het aantal klanten.

  • Je orkestreert datastromen via DAG-platforms. We werken nu met Windmill en onderzoeken een migratie naar een platform dat beter past bij onze stabiliteitseisen. Jij hebt daar een zwaarwegende stem in.

  • Je schrijft onderhoudbare Python en TypeScript voor koppelingen en transformaties.

  • Je bewaakt kwaliteit, uptime en betrouwbaarheid. Breekt er een pipeline, dan lever jij de structurele fix en niet de tijdelijke workaround.

  • Je zet LLM's in als vaste transformatiestap in pipelines, bijvoorbeeld voor het opschonen, categoriseren of verrijken van bulkdata.

  • Je houdt de kosten scherp: je optimaliseert zware BigQuery-queries, voorkomt overbodige API-calls en gaat bewust om met tokenverbruik.

Onze stack

BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, Windmill, Python, TypeScript en PHP/Laravel voor onze main app, GitHub met CI/CD, en de API's van OpenAI, Anthropic en Google Gemini. Voor infrabeheer werken we met Terraform en Ansible, voor monitoring en telemetrie met Sentry, Slack Applications, Grafana, Loki en InfluxDB. Zie je een beter alternatief? Dan horen we dat graag.

Het team

Je komt in een klein engineeringteam van twee engineers dat de komende jaren verder groeit. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de coördinator / team lead, dus de lijn naar besluitvorming is kort en je hoeft niet te wachten tot iemand jouw idee doorgeeft.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

title: AI Engineer
text:

title: International Account Executive (French and Dutch speaking)
text:
At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 countries.

How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers. Right now, that means opening up French-speaking markets, and we need someone who wants to turn a blank map into real customers, starting in Belgium.


This is what you'll do
You’ll take Dyflexis into French-speaking markets, starting with Belgium. This is a hunting role: most days you’re prospecting cold, picking up the phone, and starting conversations with people who’ve never heard of us and building the partnerships that turn into new business. You'll report to our Head of Sales, Max, and work alongside both Lily and Michał, on the international sales team.

You'll own the full sales cycle yourself, from that first cold call to the signed contract. We’ll point you toward our existing network of clients when there’s an opening, but the bulk of your pipeline is yours to build. If you get a kick out of the unknown and want to put Dyflexis on the map in a market that doesn’t know us yet.

  • Prospect and open new accounts in French-speaking markets through cold calls, emails, and outbound campaigns.

  • Qualify leads, run demos, and negotiate deals through signature.

  • Tap into our existing client network for warm introductions when the fit is there.

  • Travel to meet prospects, attend industry events, and build relationships face to face when it helps close a deal.

This is what you'll need

  • Fluent in French and Dutch. This one is non-negotiable. English and other languages are a plus.

  • 3+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in SaaS or other complex, consultative selling.

  • Experience selling into the Belgian market.

  • A hunter mentality. You’d rather build a pipeline from scratch than work on a handed-down list, and you are comfortable owning a full sales cycle from end to end.

  • Open to travelling regularly when a deal, event, or client calls for it.

  • Based in the Netherlands, and willing to work from our HQ in The Hague.


What you'll get

At Dyflexis, you'll be part of an ambitious, energetic, and customer-focused team. We offer:

  • Fixed base salary from €4,500 gross per month based on a 40-hour week (experience based) plus a performance based bonus.

  • Company car for business (and private) use.

  • Personal development budget to level up your skills.

  • 25 vacation days plus your birthday off in exchange for cake.

  • An in-house chef surprising you daily with fresh lunch.

  • The best parties, drinks and trips (Winter sports, Ibiza and more).

  • Membership at ARJ Training boxing gym (home of champion Tarik and Levi Rigters).

  • Solid pension plan and 8% holiday allowance.

  • Buy or sell vacation days, you decide.

  • Travel allowance and WFH compensation.

  • Friday chair massages to kick off your weekend.

title: Thermal Analysis Engineer
text:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented Thermal analysis engineer to help us in our mission by contributing to the development, justification and validation of our vehicle. As Thermal analysis engineer, you will be in charge of the thermal modeling and simulations to support the design definition and justification of the vehicle. You will work closely with our mechanical, CAD, avionics and mechanism engineers to optimize together the vehicle design, thermal architecture and performance. You will be part of the Nyx Thermal and ECLSS Team and will report to the Space Vehicle Thermal Team Leader.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a Thermal analysis engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • To generate the thermal and fluids models, with the right level of complexity depending on the maturity and the goals of the study,

  • To determine the thermal load cases through the entire system lifecycle,

  • To provide technical solutions on optimizing the design and the spacecraft thermal management, in collaboration with other subsystems,

  • To contribute to co-engineering sessions with various teams and suppliers to ensure the technical consistency and design optimization,

  • To support the test campaign preparation: test plan definition, exploitation for simulation comparison and correlation,

  • To contribute to the creation and improvement of the thermal analysis tools ,

  • To contribute to the validation and verification of the requirements,

  • To effectively communicate and provide recommendations through the analyses, preparation, and presentation of technical data,

  • To prepare the technical documentation and participate to design reviews.

What we would love to see from you

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Master of Science or PhD) in aerospace engineering, heat transfer and fluid mechanics, or another related field,

  • At least 4 years of experience in thermal analysis,

  • Good knowledge of thermal management for both active and passive thermal control systems,

  • Deep knowledge of thermal and fluid analysis,

  • Experience with several thermal software (Thermal Desktop, ESATAN, Systema),

  • Experience with programming (Python, Matlab...),

  • Experience with CFD analysis is a plus,

  • Fluent in English. German, French and Italian are an asset.

Skills and Behaviors

  • Strong oral and written communication skills,

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills,

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks,

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done,

The team is small and cross-functional – commercial strategy, engineering, design, and data science – and works across the full application stack, from the Broker API to the Introducer Portal brokers use.

title: Traineeship Cybersecurity
text:
Have you ever thought about working in one of the fastest growing industries in the world?

You may have, but what if you don’t have qualifications? For ON2IT, it doesn’t matter.


We hire our people on intrinsic motivation for cybersecurity. We're looking for people who are genuinely driven to make the digital world safer. People who are curious about how a digital network works (and how they can be improved), who think like a hacker, and who won’t stop until they’ve figured things out.

We will help you become the top 10%.

How do we do this? Get ready for our Cybersecurity Traineeship.

What to expect: Our traineeship is a training program, where you will start working in our SOC. We have experts in our SOC who will support you in learning and obtaining various certificates. Cases enter our SOC via our own eventflow. Our SOC Specialists investigate these cases to protect the environment of our customers. You will learn how to recognize and detect threats and how to protect and guide our customers.

We will guide you with various trainings. This does not only include technical trainings. As customer contact is an important aspect of the role, we also offer trainings focused on improving your soft-skills.

The duration: 1 year

The working hours: Our SOC works in shifts to ensure 24/7 security for our customers.
This means you’ll work in rotating shifts:
- Two morning shifts (06:00 - 14:30)
- Two afternoon shifts (14:00 - 22:30)
- Two night shifts (22:00 - 06:30)
- Followed by 4 days off

What do we offer you? Besides an entry opportunity to become an expert SOC Engineer, we offer you a total starting package of € 3.750,00. Depending on the obtained certifications, this can be increased by € 400,00 within the first year.

What distinguishes our traineeship from a regular position? Our traineeship is designed for people who want to become the top 10% in Cybersecurity. This means that your development is our top priority. We have an unlimited development budget and you'll be surrounded by top experts in cybersecurity who are eager to share their knowledge.

Are there any prerequisites? You hold an European passport to pass the security screening and you have a driver’s license and the possession of a car (because public transport isn’t sufficient for the shift times).

Can I study for CCNA while applying? Yes. You don’t have to have your CCNA-certificate at the moment you apply. But you have to obtain it before you start in the traineeship.

Location: Hybrid (NYC) - Remote (United States)

Compensation: $149K - $185K

Our client is a high-growth technology organization building an advanced AI platform designed for enterprise operations and value creation in an AI-native world. Founded by experienced leaders in applied AI and mission-critical infrastructure, the organization leverages a proven track record of developing leading risk management and financial infrastructure that has processed trillions in volume. Backed by top-tier venture capital firms with over $65 million in funding, the company maintains an agile, elite team focused on solving technically ambitious problems.

Operating with a culture centered on high-agency, talent-dense individual contributors, our client emphasizes high autonomy, meaningful ownership, and strong judgment over hierarchy. They are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer to own the technical customer journey and turn complex enterprise challenges into high-value, production-grade AI solutions.

In this high-impact role, the successful candidate will bridge technical strategy and customer execution—partnering closely with product, sales, and engineering leaders to guide strategic clients from technical discovery through implementation, production rollout, adoption, and scaling.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End AI Deployments: Own strategic client engagements throughout the lifecycle, including technical discovery, scoping, architecture design, hands-on implementation, evaluation, production rollout, and long-term adoption.
  • Pre-Sales & Solution Architecture: Partner with the commercial team during pre-sales phases to lead technical discovery, design tailored AI solutions, and perform validation for high-value customer opportunities.
  • Post-Sales Technical Execution: Drive post-sales success by building and integrating production AI systems that transition clients from initial concept into full production environments.
  • Production AI Systems Engineering: Develop scalable AI applications utilizing modern large language models (LLMs), model APIs, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context management, structured outputs, and agentic workflows.
  • Product Optimization & Feedback Loops: Translate recurring customer insights into product enhancements—identifying cross-deployment patterns and developing reusable components, playbooks, tooling, and core product features.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Identify operational and technical opportunities, formulate strong architectural points of view, and execute without requiring rigid direction.


Requirements

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Founding Engineer, or Product Engineer with significant end-to-end customer ownership.
  • Execution Track Record: Proven history of taking ambiguous client challenges from initial discovery through to production deployment and measurable business impact.
  • Technical & Commercial Judgment: Strong ability to evaluate trade-offs across client needs, product features, engineering complexity, cost, and latency.
  • Core Technical Stack: Proficiency with Python and/or Rust, React/TypeScript, SQL, APIs, system integrations, authentication protocols, cloud infrastructure, and production observability.
  • AI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, including working with model APIs, context management, tool integration, retrieval architectures, model evaluation, and performance optimization.

Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Your mission will be to identify relevant problems that can be addressed using Quandela's quantum computing technology, assess their feasibility and define how meaningful performance should be measured.

title: Founding Deployment Strategist [ERP + AI]
text:
TL;DR

  • We're building the SAP/NetSuite of the AI era for mid-sized companies in the real-world economy, starting with their supply chain operations (buy, sell, stock, produce)

  • Founding deployment strategist: you deploy two things into real factories, in the same project, the ERP that runs their operations, and the AI agents that work inside it. Every client goes from signed contract to go-live on the date we promised, running on Piston, with agents already doing part of the work

  • A rare shape: someone who has led client projects that landed in industrial companies, who is genuinely AI-native, and who will write the deployment playbook for the team and our system integrator partners

  • €3M Pre-seed (Top-tier VCs)

  • €45–60k + equity

What this role is (and isn't)

Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters.

This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it.

Why now

Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients.

What you'll do

  • Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment.

  • Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. You decide what each agent does on its own, what it hands to a human for approval, and you make sure it's still running three months later.

  • Write the deployment playbook. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow.

  • Map where the client's time goes. On site, you find the work that eats people's days: re-keying orders, chasing suppliers, rebuilding the same Excel every month. That map is the backlog of the next agents.

  • Teach humans to work with agents. The people you deploy with have never supervised software that acts on its own. You show them how to trust it, check it and correct it.

  • Hold the date and the budget. You size each deployment before the contract and protect that budget.

  • Use the tools engineers build for you. Our engineers build the tools that let you deploy on your own: AI-assisted data migration from the client's old ERP and Excel files, and a builder for screens and agents. You tell them what slows you down, they make it disappear.

  • Agentify your own work. On top of the tools our engineers build, you create your own agents for the deployment itself: configuration checks, test scenarios, training material, status reports. Every manual step you repeat twice becomes an agent for the next deployment.

What you bring

You bring the energy to deploy AI at scale in industrial companies. You learn fast from discovery, and you're as comfortable with founders and leadership teams as with operators on the shop floo

title: Propulsion AIT Engineer
text:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We want you as a highly talented Propulsion AIT Engineer to help us in our mission by leading Assembly, Integration and Test activities on Huracan, our cryogenic engine. This is a hands-on role at the interface between engineering, manufacturing, quality, and test operations. You will help turn propulsion designs into flight-relevant hardware by supporting the build-up and verification of thrust chamber assemblies and complete engines.

Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a Propulsion AIT Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Lead the assembly and acceptance testing of Huracan subcomponents, in particular the thrust chamber assembly

  • Participate in full engine builds, integrating the thrust chamber assembly with the engine structure, fluid components, valves, instrumentation, pumps, piping, and other propulsion subsystems.

  • Develop detailed assembly procedures, work instructions and manufacturing documentation

  • Define tooling, fixtures and ground support equipment required for engine assembly

  • Ensure assemblies comply with cleanliness, contamination control and configuration management requirements

  • Perform leak checks, pressure testing, functional checks, instrumentation checks, and other verification or acceptance activities under approved procedures and relevant safety controls

  • Support hot-firing test campaign preparation, including hardware readiness reviews, tooling and equipment checks, procedure walk-downs, and test article closeout

  • Record build data, inspection results, non-conformities, deviations, rework, and as-built information in the ERP system

  • Help investigate assembly or integration issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions in collaboration with engineering and quality teams

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of assembly processes, work instructions, tooling, ergonomics, and production readiness

Qualifications:

  • Young graduate in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or another related field (master's and above preferred), preferably with rocketry experience or individual projects

What we would love to see from you:

  • Experience assembling or integrating mechanical systems in a laboratory, workshop, production, or test environment, ideally related to propulsion, pressure systems, fluidic assemblies, or complex hardware

  • Familiarity with CAD, PLM, ERP, manufacturing execution, or technical documentation systems

  • Understanding with torque-controlled assembly, cleanliness practices, FOD prevention, leak testing, pressure testing, or dimensional inspection

  • Understanding of configuration management, non-conformance management, root-cause analysis, and quality documentation

  • Exposure to manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, additive manufacturing, surface treatments, inspections) and their impact on tolerances and performance is highly valued

title: Software Engineer (Golang), Managed K8s
text:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

THE TEAM

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on.

THE ROLE

You will build our Kubernetes product end to end: a metal-to-on-demand platform built on in-house infrastructure, with GPU support for training, inference, and general-purpose compute.

Kubernetes is our product, not just our platform — we run it on infrastructure we own end to end. You will decide how the control plane scales, how GPUs get scheduled, and how quickly a rack of bare metal becomes an on-demand cluster a customer can use. The decisions you make here shape how our infrastructure scales from today's footprint to a gigawatt, and how we turn frontier AI research into production systems used by millions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Design and ship the control plane. You own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions — scheduling, operators, provisioning, node lifecycle.

- Own the reliability of the Kubernetes control plane. It is the team's headline KPI. You make the calls when it breaks at 3am.

- Shrink the distance from metal to on-demand. Provisioning a cluster should be minutes of automation, not weeks of tickets.

- Partner with Product Managers to set priorities, scope initiatives, and make the technical and business tradeoffs.

- Raise the engineering bar through code review and knowledge sharing across the Cloud Platform org.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

- You have run Kubernetes in anger — and ideally built parts of it: operators, schedulers, controllers. You understand what happens underneath it, and you have worked on Linux directly, not just on managed services that sit on top of it.

- You have run GPU workloads on Kubernetes, or you are confident you can own that domain fast.

- You think like a developer who happens to build infrastructure, not an operator who manages it. You write code other engineers depend on.

As a Research Engineer on the Latency & Throughput team, you will push the frontier of LLM inference by researching and prototyping techniques that reduce latency and increase throughput — from speculative decoding and quantization to KV compression and new attention variants. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack.

This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference.

You will work closely with the Inference Foundation and Kernels teams, who turn your validated techniques into production recipes, and with pretraining and RL teams when your work touches model training. Success is measured by demonstrated latency or throughput gains, first at small scale, then adopted in production.

What You Will Do

  • Research and prototype inference techniques — speculative decoding, quantization, KV compression, watermarking, and new model architectures — by reading recent literature and forming testable hypotheses.

  • Design and run experiments to validate or refute ideas, iterating quickly on small-scale setups before proposing production integration. Demonstrate clear latency or throughput gains without unacceptable quality loss.

  • Collaborate with the Inference Foundation team to integrate validated techniques into the vLLM-based serving stack.

  • Partner with pretraining and RL teams when techniques require co-training, retraining, or training auxiliary models to improve inference.

Build the right tooling and validation platforms to facilitate AI-driven inference research.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong ML background with solid knowledge of LLM training techniques — architecture, tokenization, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

  • Hands-on experience with Python and PyTorch; you write clean, experimental code and iterate fast. JAX is acceptable with strong Python proficiency. C++ and Rust are not required, CUDA and GPU knowledge is expected but hands-on experience is not required.

text:

Advocatuur

Wil jij ontdekken wat de advocatuur jou te bieden heeft? Bij VBK kun je kiezen uit twee uitdagende stages van twee maanden: een brede stage of een focusstage. 

  • Brede stage: je werkt mee binnen twee verschillende praktijkgroepen, waarbij je de eerste maand bij de ene praktijkgroep meedraait en de tweede maand bij de andere. Je kunt daarnaast worden ingezet voor opdrachten van andere praktijkgroepen en je kunt ook aansluiten bij inhoudelijke overleggen, besprekingen en zittingen van andere praktijkgroepen. Zo ervaar je in korte tijd de veelzijdigheid van de advocatuur én ons kantoor. Op deze manier ontdek je welke rechtsgebieden jou het meest aanspreken, waar jouw passie ligt en hoe het is om multidisciplinair te werken.

  • Focusstage: weet je al welke richting je op wilt? Kies dan voor een focusstage en beleef de dagelijkse praktijk van een specifieke praktijkgroep. Een mooie kans om je te specialiseren en uit te vinden hoe jouw toekomst eruit kan zien in jouw favoriete rechtsgebied.

Let op: de stagemogelijkheden zijn afhankelijk van beschikbaarheid, dus geef je voorkeur aan bij je sollicitatie.


Notariaat

Kies je voor een stage binnen het notariaat? Dan ontdek je alles over de fascinerende wereld van corporate en commercial real estate. Je krijgt een goed beeld van de dagelijkse praktijk, werkt nauw samen met onze notarissen, kandidaat-notarissen en advocaten, en je ervaart de diversiteit van het notariële vakgebied.

Klaar om jouw talenten te ontdekken, jezelf uit te dagen en te ontwikkelen? Zet dan jouw eerste stap op weg naar een veelbelovende carrière bij VBK.


Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Meewerken in echte zaken. Vanaf dag één krijg je een vaste begeleider die je wegwijs maakt in de vele facetten van ons vak. Je draait mee in lopende zaken, gaat mee naar zittingen en neemt deel aan cliëntbesprekingen. Daarnaast werk je inhoudelijk mee door notities, adviezen en processtukken op te stellen en doe je diepgaand jurisprudentie- en literatuuronderzoek. Jouw input telt! 

  • Vakkennis. Schuif aan bij de wekelijkse praktijkgroep-lunches, waar nieuwe zaken, jurisprudentie en literatuur worden besproken. Verder kun je deelnemen aan inhouse-cursussen, lezingen en pleitoefeningen van de Jonge Balie Midden-Nederland. Een unieke kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen en je kennis naar een hoger niveau te tillen.

  • Plezier en netwerken. Naast hard werken is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Doe mee aan onze wekelijkse borrel, bedrijfsfeesten en sportieve activiteiten zoals ons jaarlijkse hockey-, voetbal- of padeltoernooi. Daarnaast kun je aansluiten bij de activiteiten en borrels van de Jonge Balie Midden-Nederland. Zo breid je op een leuke manier je netwerk uit.

  • Feedback en groei. Tijdens je stage krijg je continu feedback, zodat je weet wat goed gaat en waar je nog kunt leren. Schroom daarbij niet om vragen te stellen; jouw leercurve staat centraal. Proactiviteit moedigen we aan, zodat jij het beste uit je stage kunt halen. Na afloop volgt een mondelinge evaluatie én een schriftelijke eindbeoordeling. At Kaizo, we build a performance development and quality platform for customer support teams. Our AutoQA product uses LLMs to review support conversations against each customer's own quality rubric, automatically and at scale. Behind it sits a microservices-based stream processing platform handling over 200 million events per day (Kafka, Kubernetes on Google Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, BigQuery), and an LLMOps stack built around LangSmith for experimentation, prompt management, and tracing.

The hard part isn't calling an LLM. It's knowing, with evidence, how well the system performs on every customer's unique rubric, and having a reliable, repeatable way to improve it. That's where you come in.

What you'll focus on

  • Translate customer rubrics into AutoQA instructions. Work with real customer quality criteria and turn them into precise, testable instructions that LLMs can score reliably.

  • Run experiments that move accuracy. Design and execute evaluation experiments on large, representative datasets using LangSmith and BigQuery, and track quality with our performance metrics.

  • Build the datasets that make evaluation possible. Curate raw production data into golden datasets with balanced coverage, and generate synthetic data to cover the rare cases that matter most. QA is a discipline of rare occurrences: distributions are skewed, positives are scarce, and resourcefulness beats volume.

  • Build LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to assess system quality internally and make evaluation repeatable.

  • Make results actionable. Your experiments should end in a decision: change a prompt, adjust which tools the system uses, surface context the AI is missing, or flag where new capabilities are needed. You'll work with the AI team to ship those decisions.

  • Evaluate across the full stack. Beyond scoring quality, you'll help validate retrieval (RAG/IR), tool calling, and speech pipelines (transcription and diarization quality).

  • Join customer calls with the team to understand how QA leaders define quality, and feed what you learn back into the product.

What you'll grow into

  • Shaping how customers monitor quality themselves, catch drift, and keep their AutoQA setup improving over time.

  • Smarter categorization and routing of conversations to power analytics and get the right tickets to the right evaluation.

title: Robot Transporter (C Driver)
text:
We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

About the role

You’ll transport robots that build houses. You’ll load them at our Amsterdam workshop, get them onto construction sites, and bring them back for repairs before their next job. When a team needs a replacement robot to keep building, you’re the person who gets it there.

We’re hiring our first Robot Transporter. We already have 150+ robots in the field and we’re expanding from the Netherlands into the UK and US. You’ll be the first person dedicated to getting our robots, equipment and materials where they need to be, helping more teams build more homes.

Your day could take you from the workshop to several active construction sites, delivering robots, collecting systems for repair and getting equipment to the next crew. You’ll work out the order of stops, what fits in each vehicle, and how to load and secure it safely. You’ll drive a C-licence box truck or B-licence van, work closely with our deployment team, and get to know the robots and the people building with them.

This is practical, physical work with room to take charge. You’ll start by planning alongside the deployment team, then take ownership of routes and transport requests as you learn the sites and loads. Plans change, sites get muddy, and teams depend on you. You’ll see the houses going up and know you helped get them built.

What you'll do

  • Drive. Operate our leased C-licence box truck and our B-licence van across the Netherlands, usually two or more movements a day. When a move needs a flatbed with forklift loading, you arrange it.

  • Plan the day’s transport. Work with the deployment team on the day’s plan: what goes in which vehicle, and the order of drop-offs and pick-ups across sites, our Groningen hub and our Amsterdam locations. Over time, more of this becomes yours to own.

  • Load and secure. Robots, hoisting cages, scaffolding, inventory kits, equipment. You know weight limits, lashing and what it takes to get a 400+ kg system in and out of a vehicle safely.

title: RF Test Infrastructure Engineer
text:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As an RF Test Infrastructure Engineer, you will be the bridge between our R&D innovations and proven, reliable, hyper-scaled hardware. This is a highly autonomous, hands-on lab role. You won’t just be running routine tests, you will be designing, building, and commissioning the room-temperature (RT) and cryogenic measurement infrastructure required to validate high-density QPUs.

By implementing automated switching matrices and optimizing high-throughput signal lines, your work will directly eliminate the characterization bottleneck, allowing us to de-risk new technologies and scale toward increasingly complex quantum systems.

What You’ll Be Doing

Core Responsibilities

  • Test & Validate Devices: Plan and execute RF and DC test campaigns for VIO™ devices and test vehicles, verifying performance against specifications.

  • Build & Scale Measurement Infrastructure: Bring up, install, operate, and maintain room-temperature and cryogenic measurement setups, scaling them as R&D needs grow.

  • Investigate & Resolve Anomalies: Diagnose test failures, trace root causes, and feed findings back into device and process improvements.

  • Document & Track: Document setups and track process parameters across R&D cycles to build a reusable knowledge base.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Work with a highly interdisciplinary R&D team to align test efforts with development priorities.

  • Own validation end-to-end, from setup and sample integration through execution, analysis, reporting, and recommendations.

  • Lead initiatives to improve test repeatability, measurement standards, and validation scalability.


Your Profile

Must-haves

  • A Master’s degree in electrical engineering, applied physics, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in test, validation, or characterisation of deep-tech or low-volume hardware (industry experience is a plus).

  • Hands-on experience with RF and/or DC measurement and test methods, and instrumentation such as VNAs and SMUs

  • Direct experience working with high-density interconnects, switching matrices, and evaluating RF link budgets (insertion loss, return loss, crosstalk).

  • Proficiency in Python and data analysis and visualisation for experiments, and for control and measurement electronics.
